name: Intake
description: Intake is an AI-powered customer support platform for businesses: an agent that plugs into every channel and directly into your own SaaS product to answer customers automatically and take real actions, not just hand back generic responses. The difference from tools like Intercom or Zendesk is that the AI doesn't just inform, it connects to your product and actually resolves requests.

name: Ardiq
description: Ardiq is a distributed task queue for Python with a Rust core, backed by Redis Streams: the worker loop and every Redis round-trip run in Rust on top of tokio, off the GIL, while tasks stay plain Python. It ships with priority queues, scheduled and cron tasks, retries with backoff, and crash recovery, and benchmarks show top-tier throughput at roughly a third of the memory of comparable queues.
